description: This past Thursday, the U.S. Supreme Court made a reckless decision by siding with Bayer-Monsanto, making it harder for Americans to hold the company accountable in state courts. Elected and appointed officials have a duty to protect the people they serve. That's why it was deeply disappointing to see my opponent, Marty Jackley, use his office to sign an amicus brief supporting Bayer-Monsanto and its Roundup weed killer instead of standing with the people of South Dakota.
